summary: On each controller node, edit /etc/tower/conf.d/postgres.py: import decrypt_value and get_encryption_key from awx.main.utils and replace the PASSWORD value with decrypt_value(get_encryption_key('value'), '<$encrypted$ hash>').
questions: How do I encrypt the PostgreSQL password in postgres.py?

Where is the controller database password configured?
